title: Kodiak 50K — HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB 2026
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Kodiak Ultra Marathons by UTMB
claims: The 50K is 49 KM with 1,364 m of gain, starts at The Village of Big Bear Lake on Saturday 10 October 2026 at 07:30 and has a 10-hour limit; it carries 4 Running Stones.
The course starts and finishes at Basecamp in Big Bear Village, climbs the face of Snow Summit early and then follows Skyline Trail through granite boulders and a ridge above Big Bear Lake.
The page says the 2026 routes are final and offers a final 2026 GPX file.
